# JDC Solar
> Premium high-performance rooftop solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) and verified PM Surya Ghar central subsidy partner based in Jharkhand and serving Eastern India.

## Overview
JDC Solar is a specialized solar EPC division of Jagatdhan Commodities Pvt. Ltd., headquarted in Adityapur Industrial Area, Jamshedpur. JDC Solar delivers turn-key captive rooftop solar installations for residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and government clients across Jharkhand, Bihar, West Bengal, and Odisha.

## Key Capabilities & Engineering Standards
- **Tier-1 Solar Photovoltaic Modules**: Mono PERC and TOPCon panels with minimum 25-year linear performance warranty.
- **ALMM & DCR Compliance**: Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) certified solar modules meeting Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) guidelines for DBT subsidies.
- **Grid Synchronization & Zero Export**: High-voltage and low-voltage DISCOM net-metering synchronization with bidirectional metering, export-limiting protection, and automated diesel generator (DG) reverse-power synchronization.
- **Structural Engineering**: Hot-dip galvanized mounting structures engineered to withstand 150+ km/h wind loads, with zero-leakage rooftop anchoring.

## Core Solar Services
- [Residential Rooftop Solar](https://jdcsolar.com/services/residential-solar/): Grid-connected home solar power plants eligible for direct central government subsidies.
- [Commercial & Industrial Solar](https://jdcsolar.com/services/commercial-solar/): High-yield captive power plants for heavy engineering plants, manufacturing units, shopping complexes, and industrial warehouses with Section 32 Accelerated Depreciation tax shields.
- [Institutional Solar](https://jdcsolar.com/services/institutional-solar/): Specialized solar microgrids with automated DG synchronization for hospitals, schools, universities, and diagnostic healthcare hubs.
- [Government & Tender EPC](https://jdcsolar.com/services/government-solar/): CAPEX/RESCO execution for public sector undertakings (PSUs), municipal water pumping systems, and departmental complexes.
- [Solar Street Lighting](https://jdcsolar.com/services/street-lights/): Standalone semi-integrated and all-in-one smart LED solar street lighting systems with LiFePO4 batteries and dusk-to-dawn sensors.
- [Utility Solar Parks](https://jdcsolar.com/services/solar-parks/): Ground-mounted MW-scale solar parks with HT transmission line liaisoning and substations.

## Financial Schemes & Government Subsidies
- **PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Residential)**:
  - 1 kWp System: ₹ 30,000 Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) central subsidy.
  - 2 kWp System: ₹ 60,000 Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) central subsidy.
  - 3 kWp to 10 kWp System: ₹ 78,000 capped central subsidy.
  - Eligibility: Residential households with dedicated electricity meter from JBVNL, TSUISL, or state DISCOMs.
  - Subsidy Portal: https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in (JDC Solar manages end-to-end documentation, inspection, and meter commissioning).
- **Corporate Tax Incentives (Commercial & Industrial)**:
  - Income Tax Act Section 32: 40% Accelerated Depreciation in Year 1.
  - Additional depreciation under Section 32(1)(iia) for manufacturing entities.
  - Electricity bill reduction typically achieves capital payback within 3 to 4 years.
